whenToUse: When several saved regression models (responses of one design) must be traded off: assigns each selected model a goal (maximise, minimise, hit a target) with limits and weight, then searches the factor box for the point with the highest composite desirability D (Derringer-Suich, multi-start Nelder-Mead). Needs at least one saved regression model in the project; the models themselves are created in the regression module.
name: Response Optimization
description: Combines several saved regression models and searches for the factor point with the highest joint desirability (Derringer-Suich, multi-start Nelder-Mead).
emptyState: No saved models yet. Save a regression model from the Regression module first.
placeholderResult: No optimum computed yet. Select a model, set the desirability spec, then optimise.
lowR2: Model "{name}" has R²adj = {value}, which is below the minimum required for a meaningful optimisation.
factorMismatch: Model "{name}" has a different factor structure than the other selected models.
lackOfFit: Model "{name}" has a significant lack of fit (p = {value}). The polynomial form does not match the data — refit before optimising.
tipD: Composite desirability D — geometric mean of all individual desirabilities
optimizeFailed: The optimisation failed; the previous result stays.
resultStale: A model of this result no longer exists; the numbers show the last run, the response surface is omitted.
missingModels: Specifications for models that no longer exist: {ids}
specRejected: Please enter a number; the weight must be greater than 0.

invariants.specBounds: The lower limit of a specification must be less than its upper limit when both are set.
